description: Fix all bugs in index.html. Primary bug: voices cut off mid-sentence because showNextDialogue() advances on a fixed 3500ms timer that doesn't wait for audio to finish. Secondary bugs: timestamp shows real time instead of story's 2049-03-14 epoch, no end transition to NODEBREAK.html, portrait panel shows black bar for SYSTEM lines, text snaps with no fade between lines, mobile layout overflows at 800px width, RAF loop never stops.
steps: Read f:\Shreyash DOC\shreyash\Nodebreak\.agents\tasks\task-intro-fix-improve\context.json first. Then read index.html in full before making any changes.

BUG-01 — Fix audio cut-off: Rewrite showNextDialogue() to advance the sequence on the audio 'ended' event rather than a fixed setTimeout. Structure: (a) stop any prior audio, (b) update dialogue content, (c) if step.audio exists create new Audio(step.audio), attach an 'ended' listener that fires setTimeout(showNextDialogue, 300) after a 300ms breath pause, attach an 'error' listener that calls setTimeout(showNextDialogue, 2500) so a missing file doesn't stall the sequence, call audio.play() with .catch() also calling setTimeout(showNextDialogue, 2500), add a 15000ms hard-cap safety timeout using a boolean guard 'let advanced = false' so only the first of (ended / error / safety) actually advances. For text-only steps (no audio), use Math.max(2000, step.text.length * 60) ms delay.

BUG-03 — Fix timestamp: Replace the setInterval body. Store const STORY_EPOCH = new Date('2049-03-14T02:47:33Z').getTime() and const REAL_START = Date.now() before the interval. Inside the interval compute storyNow = new Date(STORY_EPOCH + (Date.now() - REAL_START)) and format it as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS UTC.

BUG-02 + RAF cleanup — Add end-of-sequence transition: (a) Change requestAnimationFrame(drawBrain) to animFrameHandle = requestAnimationFrame(drawBrain) and declare let animFrameHandle at script scope. (b) When logIndex reaches vnSequence.length, call scheduleEndTransition() instead of returning silently. (c) Implement scheduleEndTransition(): after 4000ms delay, set flashOverlay's transition to 'opacity 1.5s ease-in', set opacity to 1, cancelAnimationFrame(animFrameHandle), then after 1600ms set window.location.href = 'NODEBREAK.html'.

BUG-04 — Fix portrait black bar for SYSTEM/VAEL lines: Add CSS class .vn-portrait.hidden { width: 0; min-width: 0; border-right: none; overflow: hidden; transition: width 0.3s ease; } to the <style> block. In showNextDialogue(), when step.image is empty add class 'hidden' to .vn-portrait div, when step.image is set remove the class. Get the portrait div via document.querySelector('.vn-portrait') or cache it as a const at script scope.

BUG-05 — Text fade between lines: Add transition: opacity 0.2s ease to .vn-text and .vn-name in CSS. In showNextDialogue(), before updating content set speakerText.style.opacity = '0' and speakerName.style.opacity = '0'. Inside a setTimeout of 200ms update the text content and set both back to opacity '1'. This makes each line feel like a new transmission rather than a snap replace.

BUG-07 — Mobile layout: Change .vn-container width from '800px' to 'min(800px, 95vw)' in CSS. Add a media query: @media (max-width: 600px) { .vn-container { height: auto; min-height: 120px; flex-direction: column; } .vn-portrait { width: 100%; height: 80px; border-right: none; border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(63, 208, 255, 0.5); } .vn-text { font-size: 13px; } .vn-name { font-size: 14px; } }

Verify the whole file still has valid HTML structure (matching tags, no unclosed elements). Open index.html in Chrome, click Initialize Sequence, watch through all 11 dialogue lines. Check: (a) each audio line plays its full sentence before the next line appears, (b) timestamp in top-right starts at 2049-03-14 02:47:33 and ticks forward, (c) after VAEL's line the scene fades to black and navigates to NODEBREAK.html, (d) SYSTEM lines show no black portrait bar, (e) text fades softly between lines.

No audio line is interrupted mid-playback by the sequence advancing
Timestamp in top-right corner reads '2049-03-14 02:47:33 UTC' at intro start and counts forward from there
After VAEL's final line, the screen fades to black and navigates to NODEBREAK.html
SYSTEM lines (no image) show no black rectangle in the portrait panel
Dialogue text fades out briefly before the next line content appears
On a 375px-wide mobile viewport the dialogue box does not overflow horizontally
verification: Open f:\Shreyash DOC\shreyash\Nodebreak\index.html in Chrome with DevTools Network tab open (filter: Media). Click Initialize Sequence. Confirm all 10 MP3 requests return HTTP 200. Watch the full sequence — no audio line should be cut short.
Check the timestamp in the top-right corner: it should read starting from 2049-03-14 not the current real date.
After VAEL's 'I am.' line, wait ~4 seconds — the screen should fade to black and the browser should navigate to NODEBREAK.html.
Use Chrome DevTools Device toolbar set to iPhone SE (375px) — the dialogue box should fit within the screen without horizontal scroll.
findings: BUG-01: Rewrote showNextDialogue() to advance on audio 'ended' event with 300ms breath pause, 'error' fallback at 2500ms, and 15s safety timeout guarded by boolean 'advanced'. Text-only lines use Math.max(2000, text.length*60)ms. BUG-02: Added animFrameHandle for RAF tracking; scheduleEndTransition() fades flashOverlay (black) to opacity 1 over 1.5s then navigates to NODEBREAK.html after 1600ms. BUG-03: Timestamp now uses STORY_EPOCH + elapsed real time anchored to 2049-03-14T02:47:33Z. BUG-04: .vn-portrait.hidden CSS class collapses portrait to width:0/min-width:0/no border; toggled per step in showNextDialogue(). BUG-05: speakerName/speakerText opacity set to 0 before content update, restored to 1 inside 200ms setTimeout; CSS transition opacity 0.2s ease added to both elements. BUG-07: .vn-container width changed to min(800px, 95vw); media query at 600px adds column layout, portrait height 80px, smaller font sizes.
